note: No ranking, no scores. Each tradeoff lists facts established HERE (almost none) vs hypotheses from the brief (labeled H) and the experiment that would decide.

A_raw_control_plus_hardened_IO.description: general coding agent -> Python/openpyxl -> reliable writer/recalc/diff; no IR, no compiled queries

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: highest by construction (H: no new language to learn)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: lowest added risk; forfeits any capability that required harness structure (H)
tradeoffs.exploit_substrate: weakest: substrate usable only if agent queries it via its own Python
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: least: all mechanics stay stochastic unless agent self-optimizes
tradeoffs.mutation_safety: atomic write + validation only; no scope semantics without IR
tradeoffs.deciding_experiment: ship hardened I/O alone; measure capability delta vs raw control (H0: zero capability change, only reliability)

B_structured_mutation_thin_waist.description: agent -> free analysis -> structured mutation IR -> deterministic runtime; substrate mostly internal

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: reduced exactly at the mutation boundary (H: the contested cost)
tradeoffs.compatibility_with_default_behavior: requires learning IR; adoption risk (H: calc_translate_fill non-adoption is the cautionary tale, UNVERIFIED here)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: highest of the serious options IF minimal IR undercovers control behavior (H)
tradeoffs.exploit_substrate: internal only: translation lowering, closure checks, diffs
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: medium: translation/fill and validation mechanics removed; inspection/search work remains
tradeoffs.observability: best intent record: declarative batch is auditable
tradeoffs.implementation_complexity: medium (IR schema + runtime, no query layer)
tradeoffs.incremental_deployability: medium: IR must cover enough behavior to be mandatory, else two paths
tradeoffs.deciding_experiment: Phase 8 representability probe (zero-model, static): coverage fraction decides B viability before any runtime is built

C_compiled_query_plus_structured_mutatio.description: current proposal: B plus optional deterministic structural queries

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: same mutation cost as B plus query vocabulary learning cost (H)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: B risk plus query-misuse risk (projection failures cited in brief, UNVERIFIED here)
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: most IF both layers adopted; least if either is ignored (H: forced-vs-optional calc_query moral)
tradeoffs.incremental_deployability: lowest: most surface to build and validate
tradeoffs.deciding_experiment: optional-exposure adoption probe: do agents reach for queries unprompted, and does that use beat agent-Python on cost at equal capability

D_transparent_interception.description: agent writes familiar Python; runtime captures concrete mutations into internal IR; validates/recalcs/diffs

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: preserves Python surface fully (H: strongest claim in its favor)
tradeoffs.compatibility_with_default_behavior: highest among structured options (H: zero new language)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: lowest structural risk; risk concentrates in capture completeness (H: silent missed mutations are worse than IR rejection)
tradeoffs.exploit_substrate: internal use fully available (translation detection, closure warnings, diffs) without agent cooperation
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: medium-high if capture enables mechanical lowering/verification behind the scenes
tradeoffs.observability: good (captured IR is the audit log) but derived, not declared: intent must be inferred
tradeoffs.mutation_safety: depends on sandbox completeness: un-captured side channels (XML edits, macros) are the failure mode
tradeoffs.implementation_complexity: medium-high (sandbox/capture is the hard part; no agent-facing schema)
tradeoffs.incremental_deployability: high: deploy as observer first (receipts only), enforce later
tradeoffs.deciding_experiment: capture-completeness probe on existing control scripts (zero-model, static): run interceptor in observe-only mode over replayed control mutations and diff captured-vs-actual workbook state; any silent divergence kills D as an enforcement layer (it may survive as observer)

E_no_invented_fifth.reason: the brief forbids manufacturing an architecture to fill the category; repo evidence suggests none beyond A-D. Closest E-seed, recorded without endorsement: D-observer + C-optional-queries (capture first, add L1 only where efficiency replay justifies), which is a deployment sequence of D/C rather than a new architecture.
